$comment: What fixtures/sample-legacy-api is DESIGNED to expose — hand-written from the
fixture's own source, not captured from a model run. Discovery's live output is
model-produced and therefore not deterministic; this file pins the relationships
the fixture guarantees so the graph builder and the M4 scoring path can be tested
Lives beside the fixture rather than inside it: only the directory
fixtures/sample-legacy-api is zipped and ingested, so this file is never part of
the analysed corpus and cannot leak answers into retrieval.

services.name: customer-service
evidence: No test source tree exists at all (customer-service/README.md).
Locally generated customer ids with no uniqueness constraint.
OrderServiceClient posts over HttpURLConnection with no timeout.

services.name: order-service
evidence: Denormalized CUSTOMER_NAME duplicates CUSTOMERS.NAME in OrderRepository.
Unbounded CustomerNameCache that is never invalidated on rename.
payment_id column has no uniqueness constraint, so duplicate payments persist.
Synchronous call to payment-service on the write path with no idempotency key.

services.name: payment-service
evidence: Static methods over static mutable state; in-flight map never drained.
Money stored as DOUBLE in PaymentRepository.
No idempotency key in the charge path (documented as disabled in configuration).
Gateway 429 responses are not distinguished from other failures.
A locally generated payment id is returned when the gateway fails.

inventory.note: Services that appear as edge endpoints but are not analysed services — external systems the fixture calls.
